Speech-to-Intent Benchmark
	


Made in Vancouver, Canada by Picovoice


This framework benchmarks the accuracy of Picovoice's Speech-to-Intent engine, Rhino.
It compares the accuracy of Rhino with:
Amazon Lex
Google Dialogflow
IBM Watson
Microsoft LUIS
